title: Hearthhold on the hill
changes: Hearthhold, the Wardens' capital, now stands as a walled city north-west of Oakvale on the King's Highway, with gates to the south, west and east.
Gate wardens turn away heroes under level 5, heroes at war with the Wardens, and heroes the Wardens have marked Wanted.
The cities now have many more townsfolk, including a town crier calling out the news.
